name: Prof. Dr. Ali Mohamed Salah
heroLede: Professor of Comparative Religion, imam of the Tawfiiq Islamic Centre in Oslo, and author of eighteen works in Arabic, English and Somali on faith and doubt, jurisprudence in the West, and dialogue between the Abrahamic faiths.
aboutHeadline: Thirty years between the classical text and the modern question.
aboutLead: Prof. Dr. Ali Mohamed Salah is a scholar of Islamic Studies and Comparative Religion with more than three decades in academia, religious leadership and community work. His writing presents Islam in a clear, authentic and intellectually grounded way, attending both to its classical foundations and to the questions Muslims meet in Western societies.

Educated in Madinah, Makkah and Kuala Lumpur, he has directed language institutes and university programmes in Malaysia, and for nearly twenty-five years has served the Muslim community of Norway as imam, teacher and counsellor. He writes in Arabic, English and Somali, and has recorded more than a hundred courses across the Islamic sciences.
mission: To bridge tradition and modernity: authentic Islamic knowledge that strengthens faith, deepens understanding, and lets Muslims meet contemporary life with confidence and clarity.
